Filing Party                             Signer (Representative)                  Other Contact (Principal)               
------------                             -----------------------                  -------------------------               
DTE Electric Company                     andrea.hayden@dteenergy.com              tristin.rojeck@dteenergy.com            

Basis for Intervening:
DTE Electric Company (“DTE Electric”) a wholly-owned subsidiary of DTE Energy Company, is a public utility operating company engaged in the generation and distribution of electric energy in the State of Michigan. DTE Electric provides retail electric service to approximately two million customers throughout portions of southeastern Michigan and engages in wholesale sales of electric energy at market-based rates pursuant to authority granted by the Commission. In addition, DTE Electric is a non-transmission owning member of the Midcontinent Independent System Operator, Inc. (“MISO”).  As a load-serving entity (“LSE”) and generation owning member of MISO, DTE Electric obtains network transmission service from MISO for the ITC pricing zone.  

DTE Electric will be directly affected by, and has a significant interest in, the outcome of this proceeding. DTE Electric’s interests cannot be adequately represented by any other party.  Accordingly, DTE Electric respectfully requests that it be granted intervention in this proceeding, with full rights attendant to party status.
